executive_summary: Magnoflorine exhibits highly favorable structural and spatial complementarity against the PqsR Co-Inducer ligand-binding domain, leading to efficient alkylquinolone blockade and subsequent pyocyanin reduction.
next_validation_steps: Perform micro-dilution biofilm assays against P. aeruginosa strain to evaluate pyocyanin reduction kinetics.
Evaluate competitive displacement of standard autoinducer ligands from the PqsR Co-Inducer pocket using fluorescent assays.
Verify non-specific cytotoxicity limits against mammalian cell lines.
